Maria (Finance): Heads up — AWS just published a pricing update for eu-west-1 G5 GPUs: +18% on-demand, +12% for 1yr reserved. Effective in ~30 days. Need quick packaging/commit impact analysis and recommendations.

Avi (Infra): Saw it. Our Dedicated eu-west pool is ~22% of weekly GPU hours. If that delta lands, our unit cost for eu-serving customers jumps ~14-16% after blending reserved vs on-demand.

Riya (Eng-Platform): Do we have a breakdown of which workloads are latency-sensitive vs batch in that region? Can we shift anything to us-west-2 or to cheaper instance families?

Avi (Infra): Most real-time inference (chat) is eu-west for lower lat. Bulk embedding jobs + nightly evals are already multi-region. We can route embeddings to us-west-2 or ca-central with ~30-80ms extra p99 for some customers — depends on proximity.

Maria (Finance): Quick margin check: if our token unit cost increases by ~15% in eu, what happens to gross margin on Hosted API and Dedicated SKUs? I ran a back-of-envelope:

```python
# rough per-token delta calc
current_unit_usd = 0.024  # current blended unit cost (approx)
price_increase = 0.15
delta = current_unit_usd * price_increase
new_unit = current_unit_usd + delta
# new_unit ~ 0.0276 -> +0.0036 absolute
print(new_unit)
```

Maria (Finance): That moves gross margin on Hosted from ~63% -> ~58% if we don't change pricing/commitments. For Dedicated, margin erosion depends on commit mix — clients with reserved contracts won't see pass-through immediately, but our margin on new capacity will be worse.

Leo (Product): We should avoid an immediate public price increase. Customers will expect us to absorb short-term volatility. Options: (1) route non-critical jobs out of eu, (2) accelerate cloud commit talks with AWS for discount/price-protection, (3) open a temporary surcharge for new high-volume commits (last resort).

Riya (Eng-Platform): I can prototype a routing rule: prefer eu-west for low-latency tokens, fallback to us-west-2 for batch/embedding when predicted latency < 120ms for that customer. Also add a predictive flag in routing to migrate jobs during maintenance windows. Low effort, should roll in a day.

Avi (Infra): We should also check spot availability across regions. For embeddings we can use spot pools (and preemptible) to offset cost. I'll run a capacity/failover test and post numbers.

billing-bot: <link to AWS notice> https://aws.amazon.com/ups/notice/g5-eu-west1-pricing (posted automatically)

Maria (Finance): Action items:
- I will run customer-level margin impact for top 50 revenue customers and identify which contracts are at risk if we don't adjust pricing/commits (EOD).
- Avi to run region-switch cost delta and spot viability (tomorrow AM).
- Riya to draft routing policy patch for embeddings/batch (PR by EOD).
- Leo to draft comms for Sales/CS: no immediate public price change; plan wording if we need to raise pricing or introduce a surcharge for new Dedicated commits.

Leo (Product): Also need to model packaging impact: if cloud costs normalize at +15% long-term, do we need to adjust Dedicated reserved pricing or change burst pricing? I'll sketch 3 packaging scenarios: absorb, pass-through (surcharge), or move to commit tiers with blended discounts.

Avi (Infra): One more ask — we have some older q4 reserved reservations in eu-west with 3yr terms and favorable amortization. I can rerun our amortized cost model to see how much cushion we have before margins hit threshold.

Riya (Eng-Platform): If we implement region routing, we need to update docs and add per-route latency SLAs in the Console so customers know behavior. I'll stub out doc change and a console note.

Maria (Finance): Great. If anyone finds carriers or committed discounts available from partners, loop me in. I want an initial recommendation by tomorrow close: preserve hosted pricing short-term, use routing + spot + commit negotiations to protect margins; evaluate Dedicated pricing changes for new commits only.

Avi (Infra): ack. Starting capacity runs now.

billing-bot: Reminder: scheduled pricing update in 27 days. (automated)

Leo (Product): tagging @sales for visibility — they'll want to prep renewals talking points.

Maria (Finance): Thanks all. I'll post the margin table here when ready. :wave:
